correctness.rationale: A selected core-pendant matched pair cannot coexist with a third representative; each remaining set corresponds uniquely to selected distinct core roots and a choice of core-vs-pendant precisely at geodesically extreme roots. For a tree these extreme roots are exactly the leaves of the minimal connecting subtree; internal hull vertices may be omitted or represented as pendants. Exact connected-subtree weights and root/postorder recurrence follow with no overcount. The leading coefficient equals 2 to the number of simplicial core vertices. The standalone verifier exhaustively checked 293568 vertex subsets on 153 graphs; finite checks only support and do not replace the unrestricted proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The main result follows from a new aggregation of root representatives by minimal spanning subtrees, with a 2z contribution from hull leaves and a (1+z) contribution from optional interior roots, then a local postorder polynomial recurrence. The all-G projection is a concise synthesis of known corona geodesic facts; value and priority rest primarily on the unrestricted tree recurrence, not on claiming every precursor observation new.

value.rationale: The all-tree corona polynomial is a natural extension of the classical comb case to arbitrary branching, gives every coefficient by polynomial-time recursion, and exposes the tree-leaf count exactly as the highest-degree coefficient. The general core formula gives a simplicial-vertex invariant and the cubic coefficient relation. The result is more than a single small case, parameter renaming or a routine extremal bound, although it makes no unresolved unimodality claim.
